description: findu-help-v2: idempotent provider-review ticket creation via a new externalRef (ACT-{userId}) carried through CreateTicketRequest/Command/HelpTicket/HelpTicketDocument with a sparse unique Mongo index, and lookup-by-externalRef in CreateTicketService returning the existing ticket on retry (no duplicate ticket/event). Independent of the other FEATs; sequenced first so FEAT-001 integrates against the real contract. Covers plan.md item 6.
steps: Add nullable String externalRef to infrastructure/.../dto/request/CreateTicketRequest.java and application/port/in/command/CreateTicketCommand.java (keep @Builder).

Add externalRef to the HelpTicket aggregate as a reconstitutable field; keep the create(...) factory backward compatible (add via a setter/overload or extend reconstitute without breaking existing callers/tests).
Add externalRef to infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/document/HelpTicketDocument.java with @Indexed(unique = true, sparse = true); map it in HelpTicketMongoMapper (toDocument/toDomain).
Add Optional<HelpTicketDocument> findByExternalRef(String) to SpringDataHelpTicketRepository; add findByExternalRef to the HelpTicketRepository port and MongoHelpTicketRepository adapter.

In CreateTicketService.execute: if command.getExternalRef() is non-blank, look it up first and return the existing ticket on hit (no new save, no event). Wire externalRef through HelpTicketWebMapper (request->command).
Optionally seed/accept an 'Activación de proveedor' help category; if none, create the activation ticket with no category (matches current optional-category behavior).
Extend CreateTicketServiceTest with an idempotency case: when a ticket with the same externalRef exists, execute returns it and does not call save/publish a second time.
acceptance_criteria: cd CORE/findu-help-v2 && .\gradlew.bat build completes with no errors.
.\gradlew.bat test passes including the new idempotency test.
A second create with the same externalRef returns the existing ticket (verified by test: save and publishRealtime invoked exactly once across both calls).
findings:
DONE. Implemented idempotent externalRef in findu-help-v2.

Changes (all under CORE/findu-help-v2):
- application/port/in/command/CreateTicketCommand.java: added nullable final String externalRef (kept @Builder).
- infrastructure/adapter/input/web/dto/request/CreateTicketRequest.java: added nullable String externalRef (no validation; optional).
- domain/model/ticket/HelpTicket.java: added private String externalRef field (Lombok @Getter exposes getExternalRef()); added public void assignExternalRef(String) so create(...) stays backward compatible; extended reconstitute(...) with an externalRef param (3rd arg, right after requester) and set it. Only caller of reconstitute is HelpTicketMongoMapper (updated).
- infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/document/HelpTicketDocument.java: added String externalRef annotated @Indexed(unique = true, sparse = true).
- infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/mapper/HelpTicketMongoMapper.java: toDocument auto-maps externalRef (same field name via MapStruct); toDomain now passes doc.getExternalRef() into reconstitute.
- infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/repository/SpringDataHelpTicketRepository.java: added Optional<HelpTicketDocument> findByExternalRef(String).
- application/port/out/persistence/HelpTicketRepository.java: added Optional<HelpTicket> findByExternalRef(String).
- infrastructure/adapter/out/persistence/MongoHelpTicketRepository.java: implemented findByExternalRef (blank/null -> Optional.empty()).
- application/service/CreateTicketService.execute: if externalRef is non-blank, lookup first and return existing ticket (no save, no event) on hit; otherwise create, assignExternalRef, save, publish.
- infrastructure/adapter/input/web/mapper/HelpTicketWebMapper.toCommand: wires request.externalRef -> command.externalRef.
- Step 6 (optional category): no category seeding infra exists in this module; the activation ticket is created with no category, which matches the existing optional-category behavior (service only resolves a category when categoryId is non-blank). No change needed.
- Test: CreateTicketServiceTest gained execute_IdempotentOnExternalRef — first call (findByExternalRef empty) creates+saves+publishes; second call (findByExternalRef returns the existing ticket) returns the same instance; verifies save and publishRealtime invoked exactly once across BOTH calls, and getExternalRef()=='ACT-777'.

IMPORTANT BASELINE NOTE for the reviewer: the worktree branch (feature/provider-activation) did NOT contain the help-v2 port/out + infrastructure/adapter/out (persistence, event, storage) layer — those ~33 files are UNTRACKED in the parent repo (c:/.../findu) and so never came across when the git worktree was created. The module could not compile without them. I copied those untracked baseline files verbatim from the parent working tree into the worktree, plus gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar (gitignored, also missing). These support files were committed together with the FEAT-002 changes on the branch so the build is reproducible. No persistence/event logic was redesigned; only the externalRef additions above are mine.

Verification (cd CORE/findu-help-v2, Windows gradlew):
- .\gradlew.bat build  => BUILD SUCCESSFUL (compileJava, bootJar, jar, test, check, build all pass). The non-zero PowerShell exit was only the JVM 'Sharing is only supported for boot loader classes' stderr warning, not a build failure.
- .\gradlew.bat cleanTest test => BUILD SUCCESSFUL. CreateTicketServiceTest: tests=2, failures=0, errors=0 (includes the new idempotency test). Full module test task green.

For later steps / FEAT-001: activation review ticket contract is CreateTicketRequest.externalRef (recommended value ACT-{userId}); sending the same externalRef twice yields the same ticket with no duplicate TicketCreatedEvent. External ref travels CreateTicketRequest -> HelpTicketWebMapper -> CreateTicketCommand -> HelpTicket -> HelpTicketDocument (sparse unique index 'externalRef' on help_tickets).
